title: OLEANDER Landscape Architecture Design Process v0.1 — Candidate
purpose: Develop Landscape Architecture work from scope/site authority through inventory/analysis, planning/concept, developed site systems, technical documentation, construction/establishment, handover/maintenance and in-use stewardship while preserving specialist and field authority boundaries.
scope_in: landform, grading and earthwork within appointed landscape scope
surface/subsurface drainage and landscape stormwater/SuDS within appointed scope
soil, planting and landscape ecological design
hardscape, external circulation, site furnishings and landscape structures within appointed scope
landscape construction administration, establishment, handover and stewardship
scope_out: survey authority not assigned to Landscape Architecture
civil/hydraulic engineering outside appointed landscape scope
statutory ecology/arboriculture outside appointed landscape scope
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/jurisdiction authority and responsible landscape professional. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Landscape Architecture until explicit promotion.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires professional landscape analysis, planning/design, grading/drainage/planting/hardscape development, construction documentation/administration, establishment, handover or in-use landscape judgment.
design_question_types: developed landscape systems and spatial coordination
responsibility_triggers: landscape shared variable consumed by another profession
construction/establishment or maintenance responsibility within landscape scope
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid ceiling across site/survey authority, mounted knowledge/evidence, landscape stage evidence, active technical threads, interfaces, professional review, specialist/statutory authority and field readback governs.
not_triggered_when: pure geographic/context diagram with explicit exclusion of landscape professional claim
architecture merely identifies a future landscape interface
graphic planting-composition exercise explicitly excluding horticultural/site truth
mandatory_reopen_triggers: field substitution/nonconformity or observed in-use failure

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential landscape knowledge, site/survey data, soils/hydrology/vegetation evidence, regulatory requirements, product/system evidence and professional guidance must be admitted through task/claim Operational Mount before supporting a professional landscape decision.
required_methods: current Landscape Architecture professional process methods appropriate to project scope
landscape option development and professional design review
source_routes: current CLARB/ASLA/LI or equivalent professional-practice sources as applicable
evidence_routes: field observations and photos with scope/time boundary
precedent_case_routes: bounded landscape precedents only where climate, soil, use, maintenance and technical applicability are established
practice_routes: current OLEANDER landscape/site practice and failure evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current GIS/CAD/BIM/analysis execution knowledge when tools are used

stages.professional_question: Is landscape scope, site authority, appointment responsibility and information need sufficient to begin professional work without fabricating site truth?
entry_conditions: project Landscape Architecture process is triggered at this stage/claim
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential site, professional, technical, regulatory and evidence sources through the Current task/claim Operational Mount before they support a professional landscape decision or stage closure.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current project brief plus landscape scope/authority register
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when project/site extent, use, footprint or external-space brief changes.

human_experience_consequences: user/stakeholder landscape needs and access context identified where material
design_language_consequences: initial landscape character/intent may be stated only within evidence ceiling
technical_consequences: information and responsibility basis for later landscape design
content_projection_requirements: show authority/evidence gaps, not fabricated base information
required_readback: read actual site/source set against declared claim
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent or distinct landscape-professional review at the declared claim ceiling when the stage is promotion-relevant; specialist reviews remain separate where responsibility is outside Landscape Architecture.
exit_conditions: scope/authority/data needs explicit enough for bounded analysis
reopen_triggers: scope, site, survey, jurisdiction or responsibility change

stages.professional_question: What does actual use, seasonality, vegetation development, drainage behavior and maintenance reveal, and what must reopen?

stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential site, professional, technical, regulatory and evidence sources through the Current task/claim Operational Mount before they support a professional landscape decision or stage closure.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when observed operation materially differs from design assumptions.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: actual observed drainage/site performance plus civil evidence when required
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when observed water/erosion performance contradicts design basis.

human_experience_consequences: actual user movement, comfort, access and stewardship consequences
design_language_consequences: seasonal/mature landscape reading compared to intended design
technical_consequences: observed landscape-system performance and management consequences

controlling_authority_requirements: civil/drainage/geotechnical/structural/ecology/accessibility responsibilities are not inferred from landscape authorship
one current authority is resolved for each high-impact shared variable
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Actual enter/close maturity is resolved per interface / Acceptance Contract by Cross-Disciplinary Integration; LA-DP stage number does not imply interface maturity or synchronize another discipline stage.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: required maturity for current landscape claim is met
remaining item is later/outside current claim
owner and reopen trigger are explicit
no controlling-authority conflict contradicts the claim
integration_readback_requirements: change propagation after material shared-variable change

native_source_of_truth_rules: editable/source landscape drawing/model/data remains authoritative within declared scope
render/screenshot/board does not replace site/technical source
field observation record cannot exceed observed scope/time/location
execution_owner_requirements: responsible Landscape Architecture professional decision owner identified
tool_adapter_requirements: Current Skill Resolver selects tools/capabilities; process does not hardcode Vectorworks/AutoCAD/Rhino/GIS/BIM/render software
actual_readback_requirements: current native landscape drawings/data read back
field/establishment/in-use evidence read back only when claimed

assurance.professional_review: Landscape professional review at declared stage/claim ceiling, including the active technical threads and current site authority.
assurance.evidence_review: Verify site/survey, soil/hydrology/vegetation, regulatory, product/material/planting and field evidence against the claimed landscape use.
technical_gates: civil/hydraulic gate when drainage/stormwater performance is outside Landscape scope
assurance.independent_review: Distinct Landscape Architecture professional review for promotion-relevant stage closure, risk/complexity proportionate; producer self-check cannot substitute for independent professional judgment.

stale_scope_rules: only affected Landscape stages/technical threads/interfaces/artifacts/reviews become stale unless dependency analysis shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed site/survey/regulatory/technical authority reopens all consuming landscape decisions
downstream_impact_rules: changed landscape controlled variables propagate to consuming Architecture/Civil/Structural/MEP/Ecology/Accessibility/Operations/Construction interfaces
interface_reopen_rules: material shared-variable changes reopen affected Cross-Disciplinary Integration interfaces
receipt_stale_rules: Landscape receipt becomes stale at affected scope when governing site authority, stage output, professional review basis or shared variable changes

process_exit_conditions: applicable Landscape stage work complete at declared claim ceiling
required native outputs and actual readback exist
critical interfaces satisfy their required maturity
open_items_allowed: explicit later/outside-claim professional or specialist items that do not contradict current landscape verdict
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Candidate only: no promotion effect. If later promoted Current, a bounded PASS may satisfy only the Landscape Architecture professional-process dependency and cannot grant Design KEEP or Promotion.
